meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多来源深度调研自动整理成带引用的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需针对复杂问题多方位查证并输出有证据的总结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically turn multi-source research into cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multi-source research and evidence-backed summaries

howto.what: 装上后，在你明确要求研究时，Claude 会进入最大饱和度研究模式：先提议最终交付物（默认 PDF+DOCX），再并行派多组探索/资料子代理覆盖代码库、网络、官方文档与开源仓库；实时记日志、递归追查线索、用跑代码验证；最终产出带引用、含图表/Mermaid 的综合报告，并先过视觉质检。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求做研究时触发，例如说出“ulw-research”、请求“深度研究”或要求超精确调查；日常提问、调试或单纯收集上下文不会启动。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研这个仓库的 API 现状。
say.note: 会进入最大饱和度研究模式，先给交付方案再开搜。

say.text: 帮我做深度研究，比较三个框架的长期维护情况。
say.note: 会并行派多组子代理覆盖代码库、网络等来源。

say.text: 启动 ulw-research，验证这篇论文里的两个关键论断。
say.note: 会用运行代码来证实或反驳争议点。

howto.what_en: On research, Claude max-saturates: proposes deliverable (PDF+DOCX), spawns parallel explorer/librarian swarms over code/web/docs/OSS, journals live, expands leads, verifies by code, delivers cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid after visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit research request: 'ulw-research', 'deep research', or ultra-precise investigation; ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering never trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to map the API state of this repo.
say_en.note: Enters maximum-saturation mode, proposes deliverable first.

say_en.text: Do a deep research comparing long-term maintenance of three frameworks.
say_en.note: Parallel subagents cover codebase, web, and more.

say_en.text: Start ulw-research to verify two key claims in this paper.
say_en.note: Runs code to prove or refute contested claims.
